question: 2 men can do a piece of work in 2 days. How many men will do it in 1 day?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

2 men can complete the work in 2 days.

Total work ⇒ 2 men × 2 days = 4 work-units.

1 day work required ⇒ 4 work-units ÷ 1 day = 4 men.

**∴ Answer = 4**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

2 men complete the work in 2 days.

We need to find how many men can do the same work in 1 day.

**Formula used:**

Work = Men × Days ⇒ Required Men = Total Work ÷ Required Days

 
 2 Men
 2 Days
 
• 
 Total Work = 4 units
 
 1 Day → 4 Men

**Calculations:**

Total work = 2 men × 2 days = 4 work-units.

⇒ Required men = Total Work ÷ 1 day = 4 ÷ 1 = 4 men.

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**
